PILOT POLICY

  • Matching and gallery access are separate checks.
  • School galleries require guardian verification.
  • Consent for matching is separate from marketing.

PROTOTYPE HANDOFF

What is real and what IT must connect

Implemented in this prototype

  • Event and School modes with a shared 5-step workspace.
  • Upload, roster, quote, processing, review, publish and mapping states.
  • Guest consent, reference, private gallery and wrong-photo reporting.
  • Local mapping CSV download and responsive keyboard-friendly UI.

Requires production integration

  • Identity, tenant roles, wallet ledger and Store plan verification.
  • Resumable storage, checksum, AI provider, benchmarked thresholds and audit.
  • Gallery grants, authorized media, opaque redirect, revoke and retention.
  • Asset handoff, checkout, analytics, notifications and operational support.

See HANDOFF.md beside this HTML for the FM01–FM36 and UAT01–UAT15 traceability matrix.
